*Ambrose's newest marks lie under the headland. From the Holm Wood's Old Fellings and the Rim, where the pale light comes up through the trees, they can be checked.*

## Objectives

1. Look at the light through the Old Fellings in [The Old Fellings](../maps/old_fellings.md)
2. Look at the light at the Rim in [The Rim](../maps/the_rim.md)
3. Defeat 80 [Glimshade](../monsters/glimshade.md)

## Rewards

- 82,418 EXP
- 1,890 mesos
- +60 standing with [Ambrose](../npcs/ambrose_chartmaker.md)
- +25 standing with Bain Harbour
